hypothesis: R50 supported the frozen two-group-2 tied readout on reused attribution contexts. If that lower-capacity readout is a transferable mechanism rather than attribution-set fit, it will outperform full-6 on fresh disjoint contexts at unchanged state size and adaptation budget.

fit_and_evaluation.historical_fit: exact R50 historical fit identities and ridge=1.0; no R50 sealed attribution outcomes enter fitting

frozen_evaluation.supported: valid; two-group-2 improves aggregate pairwise winner accuracy over full-6 by >=0.05, improves on >=2/3 fresh contexts, and has mean decision regret <= full-6
frozen_evaluation.mixed: valid; support false; two-group-2 improves aggregate accuracy by >=0.015 with >=2/3 positive fresh contexts and mean regret <= full-6
frozen_evaluation.negative: valid and neither supported nor mixed

successor_policy.supported: advance bounded mechanism generalization under equal/lower resource cost
successor_policy.mixed: replicate once more or diagnose context dependence without capacity growth
successor_policy.negative: return to representation/readout coupling diagnosis; retain R50 as attribution-only history
